findings.failure_path: Let the original file contain two identical blocks away from file boundaries. The reviewed commit changes a value in the first block. The target subsequently changes that same value differently, while HEAD based on the target changes the second block instead. git apply accepts offset matches: the reviewed hunk no longer matches the first block, so it applies to the second. The resulting index equals HEAD, silently covering an unreviewed relocated edit or conflict resolution. A17/A18 miss this because their target changes only another file.
findings.smallest_fix: Reject replay when the target changed the reviewed hunk's original region rather than allowing another matching block to substitute for it. Add this target-modifies-first-block regression.

findings.failure_path: Git supports partial clones configured through remote.origin.promisor=true and remote.origin.partialclonefilter without extensions.partialClone. This guard accepts such a repository. If a required blob is missing, the subsequent diff or replay can trigger a lazy fetch and execute repository-configured transport commands such as core.sshCommand. A19 merely sets the legacy extension with all objects present, so it cannot detect this path.
findings.smallest_fix: Disable lazy fetching for object-reading commands using a supported mechanism, or conservatively reject every configured promisor remote as well as the legacy extension. Test a genuinely missing blob with a transport-execution marker.

findings.failure_path: The bounded packet provides focused hook-suite and mutation claims but no candidate-bound results for make test or the applicable heavy-regression, public-sanitization and repository validation checks required by the quoted contracts. The focused suite cannot establish release readiness across those boundaries.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply candidate-bound results for the required checks, explicitly recording any pending checks and keeping readiness blocked until they are resolved.

challenge_focus: Delta pass after the challenge. Open items from the challenge, verbatim: (1) P1 patch-id ignores hunk locations, so an edit moved to a look-alike block with identical context (or under diff.context=0) was treated as covered; (2) P1 in a partial clone, reading a missing blob triggers a lazy fetch that can run repository-configured transport commands. Find any P0/P1 in this delta: a way for the hook to stay quiet while HEAD carries author code the last review never saw, or to run a repository-configured program, or a mismatch between development-completion step 2 and the hook.
